column1: # java-api.tsv: removed or changed Mendix runtime Java API -> the replacement call, per call site (read by bin/javaapi.py).
# row: the replacements.tsv row the entry belongs to (R18 removals, R30 changedDate/changedBy behaviour). find: Python regex on
# javasource/**/*.java with comments blanked (strings kept); {ARG} is one call argument (no top-level comma; strings and one level
# of parentheses allowed). The first entry that matches at a position wins, so a specific form goes before its catch-all.
# rewrite: re.sub replacement for a MECHANICAL 1:1 rewrite of the whole match, "-" when a person ports it. guard: extra condition
# for the rewrite (string-args: every argument is a string literal, X.entityName, X.getType() or a String declared in the file;
# action: the file is a Java action (extends CustomJavaAction or UserAction) and defines no context() of its own).
# kind: compile (javac fails on the target) or behaviour (builds, different value). effort: per call site. source: release note row.
